slides.label: Unifesto vs Google Forms
slides.title: Google Forms is great. *Until the fest.*
slides.lede: What changes when you sell tickets, register teams and check people in.

slides.title: Payment
slides.text:
*Forms: a UPI ID and a screenshot to match by hand.*

Unifesto: Razorpay at registration, paid out to your bank.

slides.title: Teams
slides.text:
*Forms: one response with four names typed in.*

Unifesto: the lead buys a group ticket, each member claims a seat.

slides.title: The gate
slides.text:
*Forms: a printed sheet and a pen.*

Unifesto: a QR pass per person, scanned from a phone.

slides.title: Your team
slides.text:
*Forms: everyone with the sheet sees everything.*

Unifesto: Curator, Co-Curator and Crew, each with their own access.

slides.title: Where Google Forms wins
slides.text: Free forever, no app to install, ready in two minutes. Use it for surveys, quizzes and small free events. *We do too.*

slides.title: Running a paid fest? *Try a Space.*
slides.lede: Free RSVP events: no fees. Paid on Starter: 2.5% platform fee + 5% buyer processing fee. ₹500 ticket: buyer pays ₹525, you get ₹487.50 (as of 21 Oct 2026).
